# Exemptions for the org's supplementary secret-scan pass: one extended regex a line, matched against the pass's
# "LINE:content" hits. Each entry pins a whole line with its value, so nothing else on that line is exempted.

# tools/server/tests/unit/test_security.py: the key upstream's server tests start their test server with (--api-key)
# and send back to it. A fixture literal, public in ggml-org/llama.cpp, guarding nothing. The quotes are written as
# bracket expressions so this line is not itself a hit.
^[0-9]+:TEST_API_KEY = ["]sk-this-is-the-secret-key["]$
